description: Compute backend-observed pipeline latency for demo telemetry probe events.

script.source: if (ctx.eventName == 'demo.telemetry.pipeline.probe' && ctx._ingest_ts_str != null && ctx['@timestamp'] != null) { long received = Instant.parse(ctx._ingest_ts_str).toEpochMilli(); long emitted = Instant.parse(ctx['@timestamp'].toString()).toEpochMilli(); long latency = received - emitted; ctx.probe_received_at = ctx._ingest_ts_str; ctx.probe_e2e_latency_ms = latency; ctx.probe_clock_skew_detected = latency < 0; }
